build_notes: Big feature. If passed: design per-war, per-side ground/air/naval points (regen hourly, cap 12), entrenchment (defense bonus) and intel (attack bonus) meters, naval blockade (blocks trade until a naval win). Ship in stages, announce each stage.
detail: Chel, Silent and Unknown Identity's suggestion. This is a big rework and would take a while.
title: Should war get separate ground / air / naval action points, plus entrenchment, intel and naval blockades (Diplomacy & Strife-style)?
